GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid.

2. When practising Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Copy random text without understanding Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.

4. German for “school” is: (1 mark)

   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading for details.

7. When practising Listening for information Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)

11. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)

   B. Good day / hello
   C. Thank you
   D. Good night

----
